name: Uranian-Spandrel
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws towering mountain ranges, patient as erosion itself.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.
buried megastructure still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
